title: OMR Lab synthetic corpus specification
description: What `omr-lab synthesize` renders and how it degrades it: source scores, variants and the corpus seed; see docs/synthetic-corpus.md. Parameter names and ranges of each degradation kind, and unique ids, are checked by the loader.

name.description: Name of the corpus; also the generated manifest's name.

seed.description: Corpus seed. Each sample's seed is derived from it and the sample's source and variant ids, so adding a source or variant does not change the other samples.

text_fonts.description: Default text fonts for titles, chord symbols and lyrics, in order of preference; the first one installed is used. Default: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman.

id.description: must be 1 to 30 lowercase letters, digits or '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit, and not a Windows device name (con, prn, aux, nul, com0-9, lpt0-9)

musicxml.description: Uncompressed MusicXML score, relative to the specification's directory; it is rendered and is the ground truth of every sample made from it. It must fit on one page.

source.description: Where the score comes from; copied into the manifest.

license.description: License of the score and the images made from it, preferably an SPDX identifier.

text_fonts.description: Text fonts for this source, replacing the corpus default (for example a CJK font for Chinese lyrics).

condition.description: The manifest's condition text for samples of this variant.

degradations.description: Applied in order to the clean rendering; empty for the clean image.

additionalProperties.description: A parameter: a fixed number, or a range drawn uniformly per sample.
